title: A1 Final Review Part 7: Travel & Directions
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Has repasado con éxito el vocabulario clave para viajes de negocios y direcciones.

parts.visual: Viajes de Negocios (Business Travel): Flight (vuelo), Ticket (boleto), Boarding pass (pase de abordar), Luggage (equipaje), Gate (puerta de embarque). Hotel: Reservation (reservación), Check-in (registro de entrada), Check-out (salida), Single room (habitación sencilla).
parts.audio: Business Travel: Flight, ticket, boarding pass, luggage, and gate. Hotel vocabulary: Reservation, check-in, check-out, and single room.

parts.visual: Direcciones (Directions): Go straight (sigue derecho), Turn left (gira a la izquierda), Turn right (gira a la derecha), Next to (junto a), Opposite / Across from (enfrente de). Transport: Take a taxi (tomar un taxi), Take the subway (tomar el metro).
parts.audio: Directions: Go straight, turn left, turn right, next to, and opposite or across from. Transport: take a taxi, and take the subway.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la palabra de vocabulario de viajes o dirección correcta.

questions.question: I need to book a ____ to London. (Vuelo).
Do you have your boarding ____? (Pase de abordar).
Where is the ____ claim? I need my bags. (Equipaje).
questions.explanation: Luggage / Baggage claim = reclamo de equipaje.

questions.question: The flight is departing from ____ 12. (Puerta de embarque).
questions.explanation: Gate = puerta de embarque en un aeropuerto.

questions.question: I have a ____ at this hotel under the name Smith. (Reservación).
What time is ____? (Registro de entrada al hotel).
questions.explanation: Check-in = hora de entrada al hotel.

questions.question: I need to ____ out before 11:00 AM. (Hacer registro de salida).
questions.explanation: Check out = hacer el registro de salida.

questions.question: I would like a ____ room, please. Just for me. (Habitación sencilla).
questions.explanation: Single room = habitación para una persona.

questions.question: Go ____ ahead. Do not turn. (Sigue derecho).
____ left at the corner. (Gira a la izquierda).
questions.explanation: Turn left = gira a la izquierda.

questions.question: ____ right at the traffic lights. (Gira a la derecha).
questions.explanation: Turn right = gira a la derecha.

questions.question: The meeting room is ____ to the cafeteria. (Junto a).
The hotel is ____ the train station. (Enfrente de).
I need to ____ a taxi to the airport. (Tomar).
questions.explanation: Take a taxi / Take a train.

questions.question: Can I see your ____, please? (Pasaporte).
How do I ____ to the train station? (Llegar a).
questions.explanation: How do I get to...? = ¿Cómo llego a...?

questions.question: The office is on the ____ floor. (Primer piso).
Excuse me, where is the ____? (Elevador/Ascensor).
I am traveling on ____. (De viaje de negocios).
questions.explanation: Traveling on business = viajando por negocios.

questions.question: I only have a ____ bag. (Equipaje de mano).
